system.description: The priest creates a sacred aura that protects in the same manner as the Storm Protection ability, but also protects against magical attacks, both physical and mental. The aura acts as a barrier around the designated area and in order to penetrate it with magic, the weaver must make a successful Situation roll with a Situation value of 10. If the spell is able to penetrate the Vitner Resistance aura, the spell works as usual and the sacred aura disappears.
